reports.headline: Another Flash, Farther Out
reports.body: A second crater has appeared {dir} of the village {dist}, deeper than the first. {name} saw the flash from the bell tower and says it came twice, as though whatever made it was not satisfied with the first.

reports.headline: The Flashes Are Getting Bigger
reports.body: Every few nights the sky lights up {dir} of here {dist} and the ground shakes. {name} says the craters are getting bigger each time, and closer together, like footprints of something hungry.
